title: Freelance Site Contract Manager*
description: OVERVIEW We are currently seeking a Freelance Site Contract Manager* to support our Clinical Outsourcing and Contract Management team on a temporary basis. This freelance engagement is based on business demand, with project-based work packages assigned as needed and varying in scope and volume. In this role, you will work in an interdisciplinary environment with employees across Germany and the US, contributing to our mission of delivering novel PRAME immunotherapies to patients with cancer. YOUR MISSION Your primary responsibility will be to independently manage Clinical Trial Agreements (CTAs) and site budgets for clinical trial sites in Germany and Spain, ensuring timely contract execution in collaboration with Clinical Operations, Legal, and other stakeholders. Key responsibilities include: Prepare, review, negotiate, and finalize CTAs, site budgets, and amendments. Lead contract and budget negotiations with clinical trial sites, including university hospitals and legal departments. Develop site budgets using internal and external benchmarks and approved study assumptions. Apply country-specific contracting requirements and seek legal or local support where needed. Identify and mitigate contractual risks, negotiation challenges, and potential impacts on study timelines. Manage contracting timelines, prioritize activities, and drive timely execution. Apply approved negotiation positions and escalate exceptions as required. Coordinate effectively with sites, study teams, Legal, and other stakeholders. Review contract redlines, resolve comments within authority levels, and support other negotiators as needed. Maintain accurate contracting records and provide transparency on status, risks, and next steps.
